name: Know Your Meat Habits
title: Diet changes - Beginner
description: Discover how often meat appears in your meals and explore its impact on the food system. Understanding current habits is the first step toward improving both personal health and environmental sustainability, since reducing meat consumption can lower greenhouse-gas emissions, land use and pressure on natural resources while supporting a healthier dietary pattern.

name: Your First Protein Swap
title: Diet changes - Beginner
description: Explore simple alternatives to meat such as legumes, fish, eggs, dairy products, nuts and seeds. Diversifying protein sources helps improve nutrition while reducing pressure on land, water and climate resources.

name: Discover New Staples
title: Diet changes - Beginner
description: Take your first step beyond common staples such as wheat and rice. Exploring alternative staples can improve dietary diversity and introduce foods that contribute to more resilient agricultural systems.

name: Build a Meat-Lighter Routine
title: Diet changes - Intermediate
description: Start replacing some meat-based meals with alternatives and experiment with flexible dietary changes. Gradually reducing meat can improve diet quality, diversify nutrient intake and lower the environmental footprint associated with livestock production.

name: Expand Your Protein Choices
title: Diet changes - Intermediate
description: Build confidence using a wider variety of protein-rich foods and learn how different protein sources affect health and sustainability. A more varied protein intake supports nutritional adequacy while reducing dependence on high-impact foods.

name: Diversify Your Plate
title: Diet changes - Intermediate
description: Experiment with alternative grains and staple foods in everyday meals. Greater dietary diversity can improve nutrient intake while helping reduce dependence on a small number of globally dominant crops.

name: Master Sustainable Protein Choices
title: Diet changes - Advanced
description: Develop a lasting dietary pattern with a lower reliance on meat. By understanding the wider impacts of protein choices, you can support biodiversity, climate goals and resource conservation while maintaining a balanced and healthy diet.

name: Protein Diversity Champion
title: Diet changes - Advanced
description: Create meals that combine nutrition, variety and sustainability. By understanding the strengths of different protein sources, you can support both long-term health and resilient food systems.

name: Future-Proof Your Plate
title: Diet changes - Advanced
description: Learn how alternative staple foods contribute to food security, climate resilience and agricultural diversity. By broadening your dietary choices, you support both personal health and more sustainable food systems.

name: See the Land Behind Your Food
title: Product choices - Beginner
description: Discover how different foods require different amounts of land to produce. Understanding land use helps explain how food choices influence forests, ecosystems and biodiversity.

name: Every Drop Counts
title: Product choices - Beginner
description: Explore how much water is hidden behind the foods you eat. Understanding water footprints helps connect everyday meals with one of the planet's most important resources.

name: The Energy Behind Your Food
title: Product choices - Beginner
description: Learn how energy is used to produce, process and transport food. Understanding these hidden energy costs helps explain why food choices matter for sustainability.

name: Climate-Friendly Eating
title: Product choices - Beginner
description: Discover how food choices contribute to greenhouse-gas emissions. Understanding carbon footprints helps identify simple actions that support both planetary and human health.

name: Follow the Food Journey
title: Product choices - Beginner
description: Discover how food travels from farm to fork and why transportation matters for sustainability. Understanding food miles helps reveal part of the environmental story behind food.

name: Choose Land-Efficient Foods
title: Product choices - Intermediate
description: Learn to compare foods according to their impact on agricultural land. Choosing land-efficient foods can reduce pressure on natural habitats while supporting a healthy and varied diet.

name: Eat with Water in Mind
title: Product choices - Intermediate
description: Learn how food choices and food waste influence freshwater use. Conserving water supports long-term food security while reducing environmental pressures.

name: Reduce Energy from Farm to Fork
title: Product choices - Intermediate
description: Explore ways to lower the energy footprint of your meals through food choices and waste reduction. Lower energy demand often means lower environmental impacts.

name: Cut Your Food Carbon Footprint
title: Product choices - Intermediate
description: Learn practical strategies to reduce emissions through everyday dietary decisions. Many climate-friendly choices also promote healthier eating patterns.

name: Look Beyond Food Miles
title: Product choices - Intermediate
description: Explore how transport, refrigeration, seasonality and production methods interact. Distance alone does not determine sustainability, and informed consumers understand the wider picture.

name: Protect Nature Through Food Choices
title: Product choices - Advanced
description: Understand how food systems compete for land and how dietary decisions affect biodiversity conservation. Your choices can help protect ecosystems while supporting sustainable food production.

name: Guard Our Water Resources
title: Product choices - Advanced
description: Develop a deeper understanding of water scarcity and sustainable consumption. Smart food choices can protect freshwater ecosystems while supporting healthy diets.

name: Power a Sustainable Food System
title: Product choices - Advanced
description: Understand how food systems use energy and how consumption patterns influence resource demand. Smarter consumption benefits both the environment and future food security.

name: Become a Low-Carbon Food Champion
title: Product choices - Advanced
description: Develop a deeper understanding of climate impacts across food systems. Your choices can contribute to a healthier lifestyle while supporting climate mitigation goals.

name: Think Beyond Distance
title: Product choices - Advanced
description: Learn how global supply chains influence environmental impacts. Understanding transport systems can help you make smarter choices that support sustainability and food quality.

name: Decode Food Processing
title: Production methods - Beginner
description: Learn how foods are transformed before they reach your plate. Food processing affects nutrition, convenience, shelf life and sustainability.

name: Know Where It Comes From
title: Production methods - Beginner
description: Start paying attention to where food is produced. Country-of-origin information can help consumers better understand food systems and supply chains.

name: Farming Behind the Label
title: Production methods - Beginner
description: Discover how food is grown and produced. Agricultural practices influence biodiversity, soil health, water resources and food quality

name: Food Innovation for the Future
title: Production methods - Beginner
description: Discover how breeding and innovation help food systems adapt to future challenges. New technologies can contribute to sustainability and food security.

name: The People Behind Your Food
title: Production methods - Beginner
description: Discover the human side of food production. Sustainable food systems depend not only on environmental protection but also on fair treatment of workers and producers.

name: Understand Processing Trade-Offs
title: Production methods - Intermediate
description: Explore the benefits and drawbacks of different processing levels. Recognizing these trade-offs helps support healthier and more sustainable choices.

name: Beyond Food Miles
title: Production methods - Intermediate
description: Learn why food origin is only one part of sustainability. Production methods, seasonality and transport all influence environmental performance.

name: Choose Better Farming
title: Production methods - Intermediate
description: Learn how production methods influence sustainability and health outcomes. Understanding farming systems helps support more informed purchasing decisions.

name: Innovation on Your Plate
title: Production methods - Intermediate
description: Learn how breeding, improved genetics and alternative proteins affect food production. These innovations aim to produce food more efficiently and sustainably.

name: Shop with Social Impact in Mind
title: Production methods - Intermediate
description: Learn how labels, certifications and sourcing practices relate to labour conditions and livelihoods. Consumer choices can influence social sustainability.

name: Reading Between the Labels
title: Production methods - Intermediate
description: Food labels can provide valuable information about nutrition, processing, and sustainability, but no single label tells the whole story. In this quest, you will learn how to compare different indicators such as NOVA classifications, Nutri-Score, Green-Score, and ingredient lists to make more informed food choices. Understanding how foods are produced and evaluated can help you choose products that support both your health and a more sustainable food system.

name: Think Beyond Processing Labels
title: Production methods - Advanced
description: Develop a nuanced understanding of food processing. Sustainability depends on the whole food system, not simply on whether a food is processed or not.

name: Think Globally, Choose Wisely
title: Production methods - Advanced
description: Understand how global trade and food systems are connected. Informed choices consider origin together with other sustainability indicators.

name: Support Sustainable Agriculture
title: Production methods - Advanced
description: Explore how innovative farming practices contribute to resilient and environmentally responsible food systems while maintaining food production.

name: Future Foods Explorer
title: Production methods - Advanced
description: Understand how innovation can support climate resilience, reduce resource use and improve food-system sustainability while maintaining nutritional quality.

name: Support Fair Food Systems
title: Production methods - Advanced
description: Understand how global food supply chains affect people and communities. Ethical food choices can contribute to fairer and more inclusive food systems.

name: Why Packaging Matters
title: Packaging - Beginner
description: Discover how packaging protects food and prevents spoilage. Good packaging can support both food safety and sustainability.

name: Use It Again
title: Packaging - Beginner
description: Discover how reusable packaging systems reduce waste. Small reuse actions can help conserve resources and reduce environmental impacts.

name: Packaging with Purpose
title: Packaging - Intermediate
description: Learn how different packaging materials affect food waste, resource use and recyclability. Sustainable packaging involves trade-offs that are not always obvious.

name: Reuse to Reduce
title: Packaging - Intermediate
description: Learn how return, refill and reusable systems work in practice. Consumer participation plays a key role in making these systems effective.

name: Think in Life Cycles
title: Packaging - Advanced
description: Understand packaging through a life-cycle perspective. The most sustainable option often depends on the product, its shelf life and how the packaging is used.

name: Master Circular Packaging
title: Packaging - Advanced
description: Explore how reusable packaging contributes to circular economy goals. Understanding reuse systems helps support more sustainable consumption habit

name: Every Plate Counts
title: Food waste - Beginner
description: Learn how portion sizes and serving habits affect food waste. Reducing plate waste saves food, money and environmental resources.

name: Save It for Tomorrow
title: Food waste - Beginner
description: Learn the basics of storing and using leftovers safely. Good food management helps prevent waste and protects food quality.

name: Beat the Expiry Trap
title: Food waste - Beginner
description: Learn the difference between food quality and food safety. Understanding labels can prevent unnecessary waste without compromising health.

name: Buy What You Need
title: Food waste - Beginner
description: Learn how buying habits affect food waste and household spending. Avoiding unnecessary purchases helps reduce waste and resource use.

name: Serve Smarter
title: Food waste - Intermediate
description: Build habits that better match food portions to appetite. Preventing unnecessary leftovers benefits both personal wellbeing and sustainability.

name: Make Leftovers Work
title: Food waste - Intermediate
description: Develop practical habits to reuse leftovers as future meals. Reducing leftovers waste saves money and preserves resources used in food production.

name: Plan Before It Expires
title: Food waste - Intermediate
description: Develop storage and planning habits that help use food before it becomes waste. Better planning benefits both budgets and the environment.

name: Plan Before You Buy
title: Food waste - Intermediate
description: Explore how promotions, portion sizes and shopping decisions influence food waste. Better planning benefits both personal health and sustainability.

name: Waste Less, Impact More
title: Food waste - Advanced
description: Understand the wider environmental consequences of plate waste and learn advanced strategies to minimise waste in everyday situations.

name: Master the Zero-Waste Kitchen
title: Food waste - Advanced
description: Build advanced routines for storage, planning and reuse. Efficient food management benefits household budgets, nutrition and sustainability.

name: Stay Ahead of Food Waste
title: Food waste - Advanced
description: Master techniques that prevent foods from reaching expiry unnecessarily. Smart planning contributes to more sustainable consumption patterns.

name: Consume with Intention
title: Food waste - Advanced
description: Understand the connection between overconsumption, waste and environmental impacts. Thoughtful consumption helps support healthier and more sustainable lifestyles.

name: Protein Smarter
title: Nutrition values - Beginner
description: Learn why protein is important and discover different protein-rich foods. Diverse protein choices can support both health and sustainability.

name: Better Fats, Better Choices
title: Nutrition values - Beginner
description: Learn the difference between healthier and less healthy fats. Fat quality can influence long-term health outcomes.

name: Spot the Hidden Sugars
title: Nutrition values - Beginner
description: Discover where sugars are commonly found in foods and beverages. Reducing free sugars can improve overall diet quality.

name: Shake the Salt Habit
title: Nutrition values - Beginner
description: Learn where salt comes from and why excess intake matters. Small changes can support long-term cardiovascular health.

name: Feed Your Gut
title: Nutrition values - Beginner
description: Discover the role of dietary fibre and the foods that contain it. Fibre supports digestive health and overall wellbeing.

name: Nutrients That Matter
title: Nutrition values - Beginner
description: Learn why vitamins are essential for health and where to find them in everyday foods. Dietary variety helps support better nutrition.

name: Energy with Purpose
title: Nutrition values - Beginner
description: Learn what calories are and why they matter. Understanding energy intake helps support healthier food choices.

name: Build Better Protein Habits
title: Nutrition values - Intermediate
description: Explore a wider range of protein sources and learn how they contribute to balanced diets. Protein choices also influence environmental impacts.

name: Choose Healthy Fats
title: Nutrition values - Intermediate
description: Explore practical ways to improve fat quality through food choices. Many healthier fat sources are also associated with more sustainable dietary patterns.

name: Rethink Sweet Choices
title: Nutrition values - Intermediate
description: Learn how to identify and reduce unnecessary sugar intake. Healthier choices help support long-term wellbeing and better food habits.

name: Find the Hidden Sodium
title: Nutrition values - Intermediate
description: Explore common sources of sodium and discover practical substitution strategies. Reducing sodium supports healthier eating patterns.

name: Build a Fibre-Rich Plate
title: Nutrition values - Intermediate
description: Learn practical ways to increase fibre intake through everyday foods. More fibre often means more plant-rich and sustainable eating patterns.

name: Eat for Nutrient Diversity
title: Nutrition values - Intermediate
description: Discover how different foods contribute different vitamins and minerals. Greater dietary diversity supports both health and sustainable food choices.

name: Calories in Context
title: Nutrition values - Intermediate
description: Discover why calories are only part of the nutrition story. Food quality and nutrient density are equally important.

name: Protein Diversity Champion
title: Nutrition values - Advanced
description: Develop a protein strategy that balances nutritional quality and sustainability. Understanding protein systems helps support both planetary and personal health.

name: Master Fat Quality
title: Nutrition values - Advanced
description: Understand the role of different fats in health and food systems. Informed choices support cardiovascular health and sustainable diets.

name: Take Control of Sugar
title: Nutrition values - Advanced
description: Develop skills to navigate food labels and hidden sources of sugar. Understanding sugar supports healthier and more informed consumption.

name: Master Sodium Awareness
title: Nutrition values - Advanced
description: Develop the ability to evaluate sodium content and make informed food choices. Better awareness supports both health and smart consumption.

name: Optimise Gut Health
title: Nutrition values - Advanced
description: Understand how different fibre sources contribute to long-term health. Consistently choosing fibre-rich foods benefits both personal health and sustainable diets.

name: Build Nutrient Resilience
title: Nutrition values - Advanced
description: Develop a diet rich in varied nutrient sources. Understanding micronutrients helps prevent deficiencies while encouraging a balanced and sustainable eating pattern.

name: Beyond Calories
title: Nutrition values - Advanced
description: Understand how calories, nutrient density, food quality and sustainability interact. Healthy diets focus on balance, not just energy intake.
